parts.name: Handle
parts.Basic_description: The handle of the bucket is a curved steel rod attached to the upper sides of the bucket body.
parts.Functional_description: It allows the user to lift and carry the bucket easily, providing leverage and grip.
parts.Movement_description: The handle can rotate or pivot around its attachment points to the bucket body, allowing it to move up and down for carrying or resting.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The base body is the main cylindrical or conical container part of the bucket made of galvanized steel.
parts.Functional_description: It holds liquids or solids, providing the main storage capacity of the bucket.
parts.Movement_description: The base body is rigid and does not move independently; it serves as the structural core of the bucket.
